title: Dropped-Batch Excusal Points — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Clause.** On Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the dropped-batch excusal points are the drop excusal credit, capped at the points the disputed violation was recorded with. The drop excusal credit is the forfeited-offer credit plus the reliability credit plus the drop praise credit, used as they stand whenever the batch was released, less the prior-drop reduction and less the drop standing reduction, never below zero, where the forfeited-offer credit, the reliability credit, the drop praise credit, the prior-drop reduction and the drop standing reduction are each zero points.

**The disputed violation.** The most recent dropped-batch violation on the account; its recorded points are the points on that entry.

## Calculation in order

1. The forfeited-offer credit, the reliability credit and the drop praise credit are added and used as they stand.
2. The prior-drop reduction and the drop standing reduction are each subtracted once.
3. A negative figure counts as zero: the result is the drop excusal credit.
4. The excusal points are the lower of the drop excusal credit and the recorded points.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Forfeited-offer credit | 0 points |
| Reliability credit | 0 points |
| Drop praise credit | 0 points |
| Prior-drop reduction | 0 points |
| Drop standing reduction | 0 points |

## Worked example (hypothetical violation)

The most recent dropped-batch violation was recorded with 3 points. Credits 0 plus 0 plus 0, as they stand, less 0 and less 0: 0, not below zero. The lower of 0 and 3 is 0; the dropped-batch excusal points are 0.
